| `id` | `QUOTE_ID` | Step 4 |

| `expires_at` | `Quote deadline` | Create and fund before expiry |

**Step 6 of 6 · Tracking**

Check every few seconds. `completed` means PI-SPI, the regional instant-payment rail, confirmed credit to the test account. `pending_external` means payout confirmation is pending. Stop and investigate `error`.

### What to save

| Response field | Save as | Used in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `transaction.id` | `Payment reference` | Tracking |
| `transaction.stellar_explorer_url` | `Funding explorer link` | View Stellar Testnet |
| `transaction.external_transaction_id` | `PI-SPI payout reference` | Identify off-chain payout |
| `transaction.status` | `Latest status` | completed confirms payout |

Amount.description: Decimal string. Preserve precision; do not use floating-point arithmetic.

StellarAccount.description: Public Stellar account. Never a private key.

Asset.description: Stellar standard identifier. stellar:USDC:<issuer> identifies USDC issued by that Stellar account; iso4217:XOF identifies CFA francs.

type.description: Customer type, when a SEP-31 customer_info_needed error requires it.

transaction.description: Base64 XDR authentication challenge; validate and sign outside the browser.
Validated authentication challenge signed by the sending account; base64 XDR.

token.description: SEP-10 JWT. Supply as Authorization: Bearer token.

id.description: Optional existing id for an identical replay. This demo does not permit changing a saved identity or destination.

account.description: Sending partner Stellar public key. This is NOT the receiving bank account or mobile-wallet number.

memo.description: Distinct customer reference under the sending partner; preserve as a string.

memo_type.description: Use text for the demo string memos. Omitting this can select the numeric id default.

bank_number.description: Bank code. Use BIMAO_SANDBOX. Omit for mobile money.

bank_account_number.description: PI-SPI virtual bank account: 31432 Amina Diop; 41625 Moussa Ndiaye. No arbitrary accounts or IBANs.

mobile_money_number.description: Wallet number. Use +2250700000000 for Lamine Tall.

CustomerInput.description: Register a sender or one recipient destination. Sender: identity fields only. Receiver: exactly one complete bank or mobile-money field pair. Only the published test fixtures are accepted. Destination and name are immutable; use a new memo for a different recipient. Repeating the same request returns the existing id.

asset.description: Currency in which the fee is charged.

Fee.description: Service charge for this conversion. Zero in the sandbox. The Stellar network fee is separate and paid by the sandbox sponsor.

price.description: Exchange rate before fees: USDC per XOF. 0.002 means 1 USDC buys 500 XOF.

total_price.description: Exchange rate including fees. Equal to price here because the service fee is zero.

sell_asset.description: Currency you send. Keep this USDC identifier, including its issuer.

buy_delivery_method.description: Choose the method matching the receiver. PI-SPI is the underlying rail, not a delivery method.

QuoteInput.description: Provide either sell_amount (USDC to send) or buy_amount (XOF to receive). Choose 100–2500 whole XOF, equivalent to 0.2–5 USDC. The quote expires after ten minutes.

price.description: Exchange rate before fees: USDC per XOF. 0.002 means 1 USDC buys 500 XOF.

total_price.description: Exchange rate including fees. Equal to price here because the service fee is zero.

amount.description: Copy sell_amount from the quote, without recalculating.

sender_id.description: Customer sending the money. Use the id returned when registering the Sender.

receiver_id.description: SEP-12 id of the registered bank or wallet recipient. The payment snapshots this destination before funding.

PaymentInput.description: Use an unexpired quote with a matching delivery method and accepted customer IDs. One quote creates at most one demo payment. Repeating the identical request returns the same id; different instructions with that quote return 409.

PaymentCreated.description: Save id, then read the transaction and wait for pending_sender before funding. Destination and memo can be unavailable until preparation finishes.

stellar_account_id.description: Stellar funding destination for this payment. This is separate from the beneficiary’s off-chain bank account or mobile wallet.

stellar_explorer_url.description: Direct Stellar Testnet explorer link derived from the transaction hash. Null before the blockchain transaction is known. Nostro sandbox convenience field.

Payment.description: Fields appear when available. completed is emitted only after the off-chain sandbox payout is confirmed; a Stellar transaction hash alone is not payout proof.
